parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
Available side-load related resources. Multiple values can be comma-separated.

Available includes:
- `plan` - The plan for this run
- `apply` - The apply for this run
- `created_by` - The user who created this run
- `configuration_version` - The configuration version used
- `configuration_version.ingress_attributes` - VCS ingress details
- `cost_estimate` - Cost estimation for this run
- `workspace` - The workspace this run belongs to
- `task_stages` - Run task stages
- `tf_policy_evaluations` - Terraform Policy evaluations *(public-beta)*

is-org-two-factor-required.description: Whether two-factor authentication is required for the organization. Only present for invited users.

Only available on HCP Terraform when SCIM is enabled.
Returns null if the user has no SCIM identity for this organization.

name.description: The name of the team, which can only include letters, numbers, `-`, and `_`.

users-count.description: The number of active users in the team.

description.description: Team description. Only available when effective permissions are enabled for unified organizations.

sso-team-id.description: The unique identifier of the team from the SAML MemberOf attribute.

visibility.description: The team's visibility. Can be "secret" or "organization" (visible).

allow-member-token-management.description: Whether team members are allowed to manage their own authentication tokens.

hcp-resource-name.description:
The HCP resource name for unified teams.

This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

is-unified.description:
Whether this team is unified with HCP.

This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

non-service-users-count.description: The number of non-service account users in the team.

permissions.description: Permissions for the current user on this team.

organization-access.description: Settings for the team's organization-level permissions.

manage-public-providers.description: This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

manage-public-modules.description: This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

id.description: The external ID of the SCIM identity

status.description:
The provisioning status of the user.
- "provisioned": User was created via SCIM provisioning
- "claimed": User claimed their account or existed before SCIM

username.description: The username/identity string from the SCIM provider.

source-module-id.description:
Identifier of the no-code module and version this workspace was created from
(for example, private/<org>/<name>/<provider>/<version>). Present only for
no-code workspaces; omitted otherwise. Prefer the no-code-module-version
relationship for a typed link to the current no-code module version.

no-code-upgrade-available.description:
Whether a newer no-code module version is available for this workspace.
Present only for no-code workspaces; omitted otherwise.

effective-state-version-retention-desc.description:
A human-readable description of the effective state-version
retention window for this workspace. Returns null when no state-version retention policy is in effect for the
workspace, or when the policy does not delete state versions.


This attribute is only available in Terraform Enterprise.

effective-run-data-retention-desc.description:
A human-readable description of the effective run data and logs
retention window for this workspace. Returns null when no run data retention policy is in effect for the
workspace, or when the policy does not delete run data and logs.


This attribute is only available in Terraform Enterprise.

hyok-enabled.description:
HCP Terraform Premium Tier only. Enabled Hold Your Own Key for the workspace. Once this has been set to true,
it can no longer be disabled.


This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

no-code-module-version.description:
The no-code module version this workspace was created from. Present
only for no-code workspaces; data is null or omitted otherwise.

module-version.description:
Registry module version string this no-code module version pins
(for example, 1.0.0).

version-number.description: Monotonic version number for this no-code module version record.

enabled.description: Whether this no-code module is enabled for deployment.

version-pin.description: Optional pinned module version for no-code deployments.

raw-markdown.description: Raw markdown contents of the workspace README.

workspace-outputs.description:
Workspace outputs are Terraform output values associated with a workspace.
They include the name of the output and a sensitive boolean. There is an
additional attribute, "value", that can be any JSON type, including null when
the output is sensitive; it is intentionally omitted from this schema (same
pattern as state-version-outputs) because OpenAPI cannot express a nullable
any-type under the project's nullable-type-sibling lint rule.

output-type.description:
The Terraform type of the output value (e.g. string, number, bool,
list, map, set, object, tuple).

detailed-type.description:
A detailed representation of the output type. May be a string for
simple types or an array for complex types such as tuples and objects.

status.description:
The current status of the run.

**Note:** The following status values are in public-beta:
- `tf_policy_checked` - Terraform Policy evaluation completed at plan stage
- `tf_policy_override` - Terraform Policy evaluation was overridden at plan stage

execution-details.description: Details about the execution of this plan. Null if plan has not started.

agent-id.description:
ID of the agent used for this run (when mode is agent)

This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

agent-name.description:
Name of the agent used for this run (when mode is agent)

This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

agent-pool-id.description:
ID of the agent pool used for this run (when mode is agent)

This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

agent-pool-name.description:
Name of the agent pool used for this run (when mode is agent)

This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

generated-configuration.description: Whether the plan generated new configuration as part of this run

has-changes.description: Whether the plan has any changes

resource-additions.description: Number of resources that will be added

resource-changes.description: Number of resources that will be changed

resource-destructions.description: Number of resources that will be destroyed

resource-imports.description: Number of resources that will be imported

structured-run-output-enabled.description: Whether structured run output is enabled

status-timestamps.description: Timestamps for state transitions of the plan

log-read-url.description: URL to read the logs for this plan

is-exportable.description: Whether the plan can be exported

backing-data-state.description:
Data retention lifecycle state of the plan's backing data.

This attribute is only available in Terraform Enterprise.

permissions.description: Permissions for the current user related to this plan

can-export.description: Whether the current user can export the plan

state-versions.description: State versions associated with this plan (for TF <= 0.8)

hyok-encrypted-data-key.description:
HYOK encrypted data key associated with this plan

This relationship is only available in HCP Terraform.

json-output.description: API URL for the JSON formatted execution plan (available for Terraform 0.12+)

json-output-redacted.description: API URL for the redacted JSON formatted execution plan (available for Terraform 0.15.2+)

json-schema.description: API URL for the JSON schema of this plan (available for Terraform 0.12+)

backing-data-state.description:
Data retention lifecycle state of the apply's backing data.

This attribute is only available in Terraform Enterprise.

state-version-outputs.description: State version outputs are the output values from a Terraform state file for a workspace. They include the name and value of the output, as well as a sensitive boolean if the value should be hidden by default in UIs. There is an additional attribute, "value" that can be any type, including null if the value is sensitive and part of a list response.

type.description: The Terraform type of the output value (e.g. "string", "number", "bool", "list", "map", "set", "object", "tuple").

detailed-type.description: A detailed representation of the output type. May be a string for simple types or an array for complex types such as tuples and objects.

page_size.description: The number of items to retrieve per page. Defaults to 20.
